entries.summary: A labeled chip that can be removed.
useWhen: Show a selected filter or category the user can remove
dontUseWhen: Static status (use badge)
A pressed filter control (use chip)
entries.a11y: Remove control has an accessible name; pending remove is disabled.

entries.label: TextCounter
entries.summary: An input or textarea that shows remaining characters near the limit.
useWhen: Bounded free-text with a visible remaining count
dontUseWhen: Unbounded text without a max length
entries.a11y: Remaining count is exposed via aria-describedby while focused near the limit.

props.name: showAfter
props.description: Show the count once this many characters remain

entries.label: Textarea
entries.summary: A multi-line text control with optional autosize.
useWhen: Longer free-text fields (notes, comments, descriptions)
dontUseWhen: A single-line value (use input)
entries.a11y: Pair with Field or an external label; autosize disables manual resize.

entries.label: Timeline
entries.summary: Vertical or horizontal chronological list of events.
useWhen: Show a sequence of events with status
dontUseWhen: A Gantt schedule with dependencies (use @texuli/data/timeline)
a11y: Ordered list with an accessible name
Status has a spoken word and marker shape, not color alone
Item links pass the URL policy

props.name: item
props.description: Extra content under each data item

entries.label: Toaster
entries.summary: Live region that renders toast notifications from the shared store.
useWhen: Transient success/error feedback after an action
dontUseWhen: Blocking errors that need a decision (use alert-dialog)
entries.a11y: role=region with polite live updates; dismiss controls are labelled.

props.name: position
props.description: Block edge and logical inline position; narrow screens center the stack

props.name: offset
props.description: CSS length or px number from the stack edge

entries.label: Tooltip
entries.summary: Short delayed hint on hover or focus.
useWhen: Icon-only controls need a name
Optional keyboard shortcut hints
dontUseWhen: Essential instructions (put them in visible copy)
entries.a11y: Shows on focus; content is plain text or a snippet, never a sink.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut string or list shown as Kbd

entries.label: Workflow graph
entries.summary: A workflow of typed nodes and edges (automations, pipelines, approvals, state diagrams), read-only or editable.
useWhen: Show how a process flows from step to step
Let people build or change a workflow, bound to a workflow state variable
dontUseWhen: A static diagram in a document: use blocks-diagram
Quantities flowing between stages: use charts-sankey
a11y: View mode: a figure whose nodes are a list that says where each one leads
Edit mode: focusable nodes with spatial arrow keys, keyboard connect mode on ports, and a treegrid outline that edits without the canvas
Labels are text; links and images pass the untrusted URL policy

props.name: graph
props.description: A spec WorkflowGraph (version 1): nodeTypes, nodes, edges, groups, cycles.
